name: Letterpress remastering of "The Tower Treasure" (Hardy Boys, 1927)

mentions.name: Letterpress remastering of "The Tower Treasure" (Hardy Boys, 1927)
mentions.description: A letterpress book remastering project that remasters and re-releases the first book of the Hardy Boys series from 1927, "The Tower Treasure". It applies topology advancements to reconstruct the theoretical "metal die shape" used to create glyph impressions in old letterpress books, and uses a custom-built "macrogrammetry rig" — a 2D x-y panning machine made from 3D printer parts and hardware store components plus a camera with a macro lens — to scan the book's pages at around 6000dpi.
mentions.source_excerpt:
my current first application of that is to remaster and re-release the first book of the "Hardy Boys" series from 1927, "The Tower Treasure".

To do that, I've constructed a "macrogrammetry rig", which is essentially a 2d x y panning machine using 3d printer parts and stuff from my local hardware store, and a camera with a macro lens, in order to "scan" the pages of the book at the highest possible resolution I can reasonably do so at, which is currently around 6000dpi.
